text: This app has none of the issues I've run into with other apps. - Not only does it help with gaining new habits and getting rid of bad ones, it helps you understand the science behind it with small (4-6 minute) readings. - The developers are listening to the users with even little things like "a setting to disable vibrations". - This is a habit app with great potential :)
author: Daniel Madsen

text: Nem at bruge, og at tilpasse til egne behov. Jeg mangler dog at kunne se hvor længe/i hvor mange dage jeg har holdt en streak. Det kan ses på op til 1 uge og det ike nok
